subject: MAP: Bridgework technical milestones & SDK/auth streaming decisions
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sam Novak <sam.novak@acme.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-04T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: MAP: Bridgework technical milestones & SDK/auth streaming decisions

Sam — kicking off this week's MAP checkpoint for the Bridgework evaluation and the close runway. High-level: we remain on the technical path you and I agreed on, but there are three integration items that need clearer owners and explicit test windows so we can lock a firm close date.

Status summary:
- SDK integration: basic flows are in and passing (auth + generate). Outstanding: token refresh edge case (error seen in staging).
- Auth: customer-managed keys proof-of-concept scheduled for next week.
- Streaming & tool-calls: we saw intermittent truncation when tool-calls are invoked mid-stream in your staging logs.

Immediate asks (please confirm owners / timelines):
- SDK auth token refresh fix -> owner: Marissa Cole / target: 2026-10-14
- Streaming tool-call demo + test matrix -> owner: Laura Bennett / target: 2026-10-12
- End-to-end eval run (simulated load + quality checks) -> joint Redwood/Acme run on 2026-10-18

If we hit these milestones I can recommend ramping the MAP close to the week of 2026-10-25. If any of the three slip more than 3 business days, we should agree to a contingency shift.

I've attached the updated MAP-v2_roadmap.xlsx and a short streaming-test-plan draft. Also linking our shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAPBridgework

Thanks — want to make the remaining steps as low risk as possible.

--
Karthik Iyer
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
(415) 555-0147

Attachment: MAP-v2_roadmap.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Sam Novak <sam.novak@acme.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha.sec@acme.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T14:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Bridgework technical milestones & SDK/auth streaming decisions

Thanks Karthik — good summary. A couple quick data points from our side:

- We saw the token refresh failure surface in two of our micro-batches on 2026-10-03; it causes a soft 500 under load but isn’t deterministic.
- The streaming truncation happens when the tool-call payload is ~>2.5k tokens and the call returns a nested JSON payload. We can reproduce reliably in our staging environment.

Aisha (security) also asked whether the customer-managed KMS POC will require additional paperwork for our compliance team. She’s copied to follow up.

Proposed changes to the MAP timeline: given the reproducible truncation, we would like to allow one extra week for the streaming test window (so streaming demo target -> 2026-10-19). If Redwood can prioritise the SDK auth token refresh, we will keep the E2E eval on 2026-10-18; otherwise we should rebase the eval to 2026-10-25.

Happy to run a short session with your engineers this week so we can walk through our failing reproducer. Can you propose 30–45 min slots?

Best,
Sam
Principal Engineer, Acme Corp
sam.novak@acme.com

On Mon, Oct 4, 2026 at 3:02 PM Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> Sam — kicking off this week's MAP checkpoint for the Bridgework evaluation and the close runway...
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: Sam Novak <sam.novak@acme.com>
Date: 2026-10-08T09:13:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Bridgework technical milestones & SDK/auth streaming decisions

Laura / Marissa — copying you to lock owner commitments after Sam's note. Updated action list below (I adjusted streaming target per Acme's ask):

Updated action items (owners & firm dates):
- Marissa Cole: implement SDK token refresh retries + add unit tests; deploy to staging for Acme repro by 2026-10-14 EOD. (Attachment: streaming-test-plan.pdf outlines repro steps.)
- Laura Bennett: run a focused streaming/tool-call demo using Acme's reproducer; capture fulltrace logs and a regression checklist; target window 2026-10-19 09:00–12:00 PT.
- Karthik Iyer: coordinate joint E2E eval and confirm load profile with Acme by 2026-10-11.

Meeting slots for debugging session with Acme (Sam): 2026-10-09 11:00 PT or 2026-10-09 15:30 PT. Please confirm availability ASAP so I can send the invite.

Notes on acceptance criteria for the eval run:
- No token refresh 500s under the agreed load profile (95th percentile latency under 500ms).
- Streaming tool-calls should not truncate JSON payloads; full payload must arrive and deserialization must succeed in our handler.
- Regression tests added to the MAP test harness and linked in the Drive folder.

I'll hold the MAP close recommendation until the E2E run passes these bullets. If all green, we will proceed with procurement/ops handover for a pilot in the week of 2026-10-25.

--
Karthik

Attachment: streaming-test-plan.pdf (PDF)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Sam Novak <sam.novak@acme.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T10:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Bridgework technical milestones & SDK/auth streaming decisions

Confirming ownership and progress notes:

- SDK token refresh: initial fix merged to feature/token-retries branch; CI shows the new unit tests covering the edge case. I will deploy to the Acme staging snapshot on 2026-10-14 as planned and post results in the Drive folder.
- I can join the 2026-10-09 11:00 PT slot for the reproduce/debug session (if we still want that earlier slot) — otherwise I will be present for the streaming demo on 2026-10-19.

I'll update the HubSpot MAP record after the staging deploy (HubSpot:HS-19872) and attach the test run notes.

-Marissa
Sr. Software Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
